[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant offered to help troubleshoot the user's phone battery life issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested lowering screen brightness or enabling auto-brightness to reduce battery consumption.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested enabling power-saving features like Low Power Mode or Power Saver.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised regularly closing unused apps to prevent battery drain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended updating the phone's operating system for battery life improvements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested clearing cache and data of apps to improve performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended calibrating the phone's battery by draining it to 0% and charging it to 100%.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that cleaning the phone's screen is unlikely to have a direct impact on battery life.
